description: Source code for aom video decoder implementation within the starboard shared library, handling AV1 decoding, decode target management, and error reporting.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: Implements AV1 video decoding using the AOM library, manages decode targets, and handles error reporting.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::VideoDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the video decoder with specified codec, output mode, and graphics context provider.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::~VideoDecoder
methods.description: Destructor that resets the decoder state.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with status and error callback functions.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream and flushes remaining frames.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state and cancels pending jobs.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::UpdateDecodeTarget_Locked
methods.description: Updates the decode target with the current frame.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::ReportError
methods.description: Reports an error and invokes the error callback.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::InitializeCodec
methods.description: Initializes the AOM AV1 decoder with specific configuration.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::TeardownCodec
methods.description: Destroys the decoder and releases decode targets.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::DecodeOneBuffer
methods.description: Decodes a single input buffer and creates a video frame.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decode target in decode-to-texture mode.
